color-neutral-50.$description: Lightest step of the neutral ramp in light mode, darkest in dark mode. The page background resolves here.

color-neutral-100.$description: Second step of the neutral ramp. Secondary surfaces and skeleton highlights resolve here.

color-neutral-200.$description: Third step of the neutral ramp. Default borders, tertiary surfaces and the skeleton base resolve here.

color-neutral-300.$description: Fourth step of the neutral ramp. The route-transition curtain resolves here.

color-neutral-400.$description: Fifth step of the neutral ramp. Strong borders on form controls resolve here.

color-neutral-600.$description: Seventh step of the neutral ramp. Secondary text resolves here.

color-neutral-700.$description: Eighth step of the neutral ramp.

color-neutral-800.$description: Ninth step of the neutral ramp. The base accent resolves here.

color-neutral-900.$description: Strongest step of the neutral ramp: near-black in light mode, near-white in dark. Inverse surfaces resolve here.

color-surface-primary.$description: The page background, and containers that sit flat on it: cards, dialogs, drawers, menus, form fields.

color-surface-secondary.$description: A second surface layer: hover and selected fills on tabs, nav items, pagination and accordion triggers.

color-surface-tertiary.$description: A third surface layer, for contrast against the secondary one. Switch tracks use it.

color-surface-inverse.$description: Background for dark-on-light moments, such as tooltips. Flips with the mode.

color-text-secondary.$description: Supporting text: hints, captions, metadata, inactive tabs.

color-accent-default.$description: Primary actions and selected states: filled buttons, checked controls, the active tab. Near-black in base; a brand puts its own colour here.

color-accent-foreground.$description: Text and icons on an accent fill.

color-border-default.$description: Dividers and the outlines of cards, tables, menus and fields.

color-border-strong.$description: Outlines that must read as interactive: form fields, checkboxes, radios, switches.

color-border-focus.$description: The focus ring. Pairs with focus-ring-width and focus-ring-offset.

color-curtain.$description: Fill of the full-screen curtain shown during route transitions.

color-feedback-error.$description: Error text, icons and borders on the page background: invalid fields, destructive menu items.

color-feedback-error-background.$description: Background of an error Alert or Badge.

color-feedback-error-foreground.$description: Text and icons inside an error Alert, Toast or Badge.

color-feedback-error-border.$description: Border and accent stripe of an error Alert, Toast or Badge.

color-feedback-success-background.$description: Background of a success Alert or Badge.

color-feedback-success-foreground.$description: Text and icons inside a success Alert, Toast or Badge.

color-feedback-success-border.$description: Border and accent stripe of a success Alert, Toast or Badge.

color-feedback-warning-background.$description: Background of a warning Alert or Badge.

color-feedback-warning-foreground.$description: Text and icons inside a warning Alert, Toast or Badge.

color-feedback-warning-border.$description: Border and accent stripe of a warning Alert, Toast or Badge.

color-feedback-info-background.$description: Background of an info Alert or Badge.

color-feedback-info-foreground.$description: Text and icons inside an info Alert, Toast or Badge.

color-feedback-info-border.$description: Border and accent stripe of an info Alert, Toast or Badge.

color-skeleton-base.$description: Resting colour of a loading Skeleton.

color-skeleton-highlight.$description: The colour a loading Skeleton pulses towards.

focus-ring-offset.$description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

shadow-card-hover.$description: Shadow a clickable Card lifts to on hover.

shadow-dropdown.$description: Shadow under floating lists: Menu, NavigationMenu dropdowns, Select.

shadow-dialog.$description: Shadow on overlay panels. Drawer uses it.

shadow-toast.$description: Shadow under Toasts and Tooltips, which float above everything else.

z-dropdown.$description: Stacking level for NavigationMenu's dropdown, above page content.

z-toast.$description: Stacking level for the Toast viewport, above dialogs.

z-tooltip.$description: Stacking level for Tooltips, the top of the normal stack.

z-skip-link.$description: SkipLink only: one step above everything else. The one justified explicit z-index after decisions/0007 — a skip link isn't portalled, so mount order can't lift it, and it must sit above every other layer the moment it's focused.

size-icon-xs.$description: 12px icon, such as Link's external-link arrow.

size-icon-sm.$description: 16px icon, inline with control text: menu items, nav chevrons, the small Spinner.

size-icon-md.$description: 20px icon: Alert and Toast status icons, the Accordion chevron, the default Spinner.

size-icon-xl.$description: 32px icon, for standalone icons such as footer links.

duration-spin.$description: One full turn of the Spinner.

font-family-base.$description: Typeface for body text and controls. A system stack in base; a brand sets its own.

font-family-heading.$description: Typeface for headings. A system stack in base; a brand sets its own.

font-family-mono.$description: Typeface for code: JetBrains Mono. tokens/fonts.json has the Google Fonts link that loads it.

font-size-control.$description: Default text size for form controls and interactive components (inputs, buttons, tabs). Distinct from font-size-body (prose). See decisions/0004.

font-size-small.$description: 14px text: wrapping secondary text (pairs with line-height-small) and single-line form-field labels (pair with line-height-label). font-size-label merged into this role — see decisions/0013.

font-size-caption.$description: 12px supporting text: hints, tooltips, table headers and captions, badges, tags, and consumer-side eyebrows or metadata. Pairs with line-height-caption — see decisions/0012.

font-size-h1.$description: Static H1 size: 64px. Pairs with line-height-h1.

font-size-h1-fluid.$description: H1 that scales with the viewport, from 28px to 64px.

font-size-h2.$description: Static H2 size: 48px. Pairs with line-height-h2.

font-size-h2-fluid.$description: H2 that scales with the viewport, from 26px to 48px.

font-size-h3.$description: Static H3 size: 32px. Pairs with line-height-h3.

font-size-h3-fluid.$description: H3 that scales with the viewport, from 24px to 40px.

font-size-h5.$description: Static (not fluid) by design — see decisions/0008. Pairs with its own fixed line-height role (decisions/0012) and letter-spacing-heading.

font-weight-label.$description: Weight for form-field labels (input, select, textarea, standalone Label). Corrected from semibold to medium, Sep 2026 — the role existed but was set to the wrong value and unused by any label component. See decisions/0004.

font-weight-display.$description: Weight for large display text, such as a page's opening headline.

font-weight-title.$description: Title weight for card/dialog/drawer-style container headers. See decisions/0004.

font-weight-control.$description: Default text weight for interactive controls (button, tabs trigger, accordion trigger). Pairs with font-size-control. See decisions/0004.

line-height-display.$description: Line height for fluid H1 and display text, where a fixed px value would break the scaling.

line-height-body.$description: Strict-4px-grid line-height for font-size-body (18px). Redefined from unitless 1.5 to a fixed 4px-grid value — see decisions/0012.

line-height-control.$description: Strict-4px-grid line-height for font-size-control (16px) — see decisions/0012.

line-height-small.$description: Strict-4px-grid line-height for font-size-small (14px) — see decisions/0012.

line-height-caption.$description: Strict-4px-grid line-height for font-size-caption (12px) — see decisions/0012.

line-height-h1.$description: Strict-4px-grid line-height for font-size-h1 (64px, static) — see decisions/0012. The fluid font-size-h1-fluid keeps line-height-display.

line-height-h2.$description: Strict-4px-grid line-height for font-size-h2 (48px, static) — see decisions/0012. The fluid font-size-h2-fluid keeps line-height-heading.

line-height-h3.$description: Strict-4px-grid line-height for font-size-h3 (32px, static) — see decisions/0012. The fluid font-size-h3-fluid keeps line-height-heading.

line-height-h4.$description: Strict-4px-grid line-height for font-size-h4 (24px) — see decisions/0012.

line-height-h5.$description: Strict-4px-grid line-height for font-size-h5 (20px) — see decisions/0012.

line-height-heading.$description: Line height for fluid H2 and H3.

line-height-label.$description: Strict-4px-grid line-height for single-line form-field labels at font-size-small (14px) — see Label.css and decisions/0013.

letter-spacing-heading.$description: Tightened tracking for headings and titles.

letter-spacing-label.$description: Slightly open tracking for small labels and metadata.

letter-spacing-wide.$description: Wide tracking for uppercase eyebrows and overlines.

space-layout-margin.$description: Page gutter on each side, from 20px on small screens to 32px.

space-section-gap.$description: Space between page sections, from 48px to 80px with the viewport.

space-component-gap.$description: Space between larger blocks inside a component, such as a dialog's header, body and footer.

space-element-gap.$description: Space between elements inside a component, such as a card's title and body.

space-inline-gap.$description: Space between items in a row: an icon and its label, buttons in a group.

space-label-gap.$description: Space between a control and its label, or a status icon and its message.

border-radius-component.$description: Corners of containers: cards, dialogs, menus, alerts, tables.

border-radius-interactive.$description: Corners of controls: inputs, menu items, tab triggers, close buttons.

border-radius-image.$description: Corners of images inside a Card.

border-radius-pill.$description: Fully rounded ends: pill buttons, badges, tags, avatars, switch tracks.

duration-interaction.$description: Hover, press and focus changes on controls.

duration-transition.$description: Overlays and messages entering or leaving: dialogs, drawers, toasts, dismissing an alert.

duration-entrance.$description: Larger entrance animations on page content, slower than duration-transition.

duration-reveal.$description: Content fading and sliding into view as it scrolls in.

duration-reveal-delay.$description: Stagger delay for elements that follow a reveal into view

space-tight-gap.$description: The smallest gap, between tightly grouped items such as tab triggers or nav items.

space-control-padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding for default-size form controls and interactive components (input, select, table cell, tabs trigger, textarea). See decisions/0004.

space-control-padding-y.$description: Vertical padding for default-size form controls and interactive components (input, select, table cell, tabs trigger, textarea). See decisions/0004.

space-prominent-padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding for prominent container-style components (accordion trigger, alert, toast). See decisions/0004.

space-prominent-padding-y.$description: Vertical padding for prominent container-style components (accordion trigger, alert, toast). See decisions/0004.

space-compact-padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding for compact/small-size controls (tooltip, tabs small trigger). See decisions/0004.

space-compact-padding-y.$description: Vertical padding for compact/small-size controls (tooltip, tabs small trigger). See decisions/0004.

space-container-padding.$description: All-around padding for standard container-style components (card, hero, datatable empty state, empty-state compact horizontal). See decisions/0004.

space-container-padding-lg.$description: All-around padding for larger overlay-style containers (drawer, empty-state compact vertical). Dialog no longer uses this directly — see space-dialog-padding-* for its responsive replacement (docs/backlog.md, space-scale-expansion item).

space-dialog-padding-mobile.$description: Dialog content padding below the tablet breakpoint (max-width: 767px). Pairs with space-dialog-padding-tablet/-desktop, switched via @media in Dialog.css rather than resolved by the token layer — no per-breakpoint token resolution exists in the build pipeline yet.

space-dialog-padding-tablet.$description: Dialog content padding from the tablet breakpoint (min-width: 768px). See space-dialog-padding-mobile.

space-dialog-padding-desktop.$description: Dialog content padding from the desktop breakpoint (min-width: 1024px). See space-dialog-padding-mobile.

space-layout-max-width.$description: Deprecated: use the size-container-* scale (decisions/0014). Kept at 1200px so existing layouts don't move; to be removed in a later release.

border-width-interactive.$description: Border on form controls and menus.

border-width-default.$description: Static, non-interactive borders (cards, dialogs, dividers, badges). See decisions/0004.

size-container-text.$description: Max width for running text (720px at a 16px root, about 65 characters of font-size-body). Use directly as max-width, or as min(var(--size-container-text), 100%) for width or grid tracks. See decisions/0014.

size-container-media.$description: Max width for text with media: images, embeds, diagrams sitting in a text column (960px, 4/3 of size-container-text). See decisions/0014.

size-container-wide.$description: Max width for wide media that breaks out past size-container-media (1280px, 4/3 of it). See decisions/0014.

size-container-page.$description: Max width of a page's centred content area (1440px). See decisions/0014.

size-container-site.$description: Outer site frame from 1024px up (90vw). Below 1024px the site is 100% wide with space-layout-margin gutters. Custom properties can't be read in @media, so apply this inside a (min-width: 1024px) query: breakpoint.desktop, decisions/0018. See decisions/0014.
